newsitem.title: USA: Firm weighs sale of Penn Virginia stake.
newsitem.headline: Firm weighs sale of Penn Virginia stake.

text.p: Interkohle Beteiligung GmbH said Friday it was considering the possible sale of its 19.5 percent stake in Penn Virginia Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the German firm said that following a recent review of all of its investments, "it has concluded that ownership of the shares (in Penn Virginia) is no longer necessary" for the company.

It said it may sell the 868,258 shares it holds in Penn Virginia in an underwritten offering, through open market sales or in privately negotiated transactions or other means depending on market conditions and other factors.
